name: Alto Longá (Brazil)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and green, the white charged with the municipal arms: a light blue shield with palm trees under a green star, between sugar cane and cattle.
history: Alto Longá is a municipality in the state of Piauí, Brazil.

features.role: municipal arms with a light blue shield bearing palm trees, between sugar cane and cattle, reading ALTO LONGÁ
